title: 二口消火栓
description: フランジ、六角ボルト、キャップ、保持チェーンを個別に造形した汎用消火栓。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: Generic two-outlet hydrant with cast barrel profile, bolted flanges, removable-looking caps, wrench nuts and individually modeled retaining-chain links. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.

provenance.rights: Original geometry and material design created for Xenoah Meshcopia under the owner request for CC-BY-4.0 publication. No third-party meshes, scans, brands, logos or font files.
provenance.alternateFormat: STL triangulated from the exact reimported GLB using Blender 4.3.2, meters and Y-up; no printability or manufacturing validation.

usages.context: Original city asset created for this library. No external deployment or reuse claimed.
